load_mauve_metric: load the mauve metric from Hugging Face evaluate library for text distribution analysis
launch_gradio_widget: launch a gradio widget interface for the mauve metric evaluation
run_mauve_evaluation: run mauve metric evaluation to compare human and model text distributions
compute_mauve_scores: compute mauve scores measuring the divergence between human and generated text
evaluate_text_similarity: evaluate text similarity using mauve metric to assess model-generated text quality
